REPLAYABLE.definition: Stored answers cover all applicable questions; option identities resolve; assessment version is pinned; legacy result may be recomputed for comparison only.

LEGACY_PRESERVE.definition: A legacy result exists but answer-level source is incomplete or absent.

UNRECONSTRUCTABLE.definition: Required historical identity/score lineage is absent or inconsistent.

gates: Never replace historical visible results without an explicit versioned migration.
P3 shadow results must retain legacy result independently.
Assessment version and legacy scoring engine version must remain attributable.
A missing answer source is a data-retention limitation, not evidence for a zero or inferred response.
Historical trap penalties are not reintroduced during reconciliation.
Any numerical difference between legacy and P3 is a comparison artifact until migration approval.
requiredBeforeProductionMigration: shadow-replay evidence for every replayable session
owner decision on historical display policy
